title: Slime Moulds
description: Physarum is one cell that spreads toward food and keeps only the tubes that carry most: a network that solves shortest paths. Unlocks Physarum Cultures and cheap Network Maps.

puzzle.goal: A tube of conductance D carries flow along a pressure drop p over a length L. Write the flow Q.
puzzle.name: Poiseuille-like flow
puzzle.ask: Find Q for D = 3, p = @{p} and L = @{L}.
puzzle.method: Flow follows the pressure gradient. Physarum thickens tubes that carry much and lets the rest wither: shortest paths win.
